channel.title: 龍庭 dragon court — log
channel.description: A terminal in the dark: machines that check before they claim, and the eight aspects that keep them honest.

item.title: eight seats at one terminal
item.description: Why the court has eight seats and not one voice: a seat is an interface, vacancy is the honest default, and roles are cheaper to verify than identities.

item.title: verify, then claim
item.description: A green check is not a working thing. Three questions, three instruments: evaluation, build, ledger — and why saying "it evaluates" is the honest sentence.

item.title: nothing here survives a reboot
item.description: The machine forgets on purpose: if it is not declared it does not exist, the persistence list is a budget rather than a wishlist, and what survives is exactly what you wrote down.
